title: Bayrunner Fishing Charters

services.name: Phantom
services.desc: About A 26 ft. Pathfinder with a 300 hp Yamaha (Up to 4 People). This boat is a Bayrunner on steroids! Two feet longer, wider and sporting a deeper v hull with twin steps, it cruises 38 mph in 3 foot seas as if it was flat calm! Fish everywhere the Bayrunner does with added offshore capability for fishing the reefs up to 30 miles offshore on 6 - 8 hour trips. Rates 3 hr (shark) - $495 4 hr - $625 5 hr - $725 6 hr - $850 8 hr - $1195 Shark Trip – 3 hour evening shark fishing excursion offered May –

services.name: Bay Runner
services.desc: About 24 ft. (Up to 4 people) Fishing Charters starting at 3 hours in the local creeks and sounds for a wide variety of species. Capability of fishing waters as shallow as 12 inches and the comfort to take on near-shore reefs. Rates 3 hr (shark) - $495 4 hr - $625 5 hr - $725 6 hr - $850 8 hr - $1195 Shark Trip – 3 hour evening shark fishing excursion offered May –

services.name: Fin-atic
services.desc: About 26 ft. (Up to 12 people) Fishing Charters starting at 3 hours and primarily fished in Hilton Head Island's Calibogue Sound for sharks and other species. The Finatic is a great boat for families and groups. Nature tours and dolphin cruises are also available. Shark Trip – 3-hour evening shark fishing excursion offered
